content: Diigi-dule-oged-Juan Bab-Dummad-igargi sunmaksad

Birgambe-gakatargus (15) Tiberio-César Romaʼgi-negdakmaidgi, Poncio-Pilato deun Judea-yargi dummadga maid. Degi, Herodes Galilea-yargi dummadga maimogad, e-urba-Felipe Iturea-yargi, degi, Traconite-yargi dummadga maimogad. Degine, Lisanias, Abilinia-yargi dummadga maimogad.
Deunni, Anás, Caifás-ebo dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummadga maimogad. A-ibagangine, Bab-Dummad Zacarías-machi-Juanʼse gornonikid. Deun, Juan nega-dulesulidganba gudiid.

Juan bela Jordán-diwar-dikarba-neggwebur-bukmaladse nadegusad. Dulemarga Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igargi sunmakdii gusad, degi, na e-isgumaladga bukib-binsamarye sogdii gusad. Adi, e-daed gwagmalagar, adi, isguedgi abonolemalagar.
Epenne Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías, Juanʼnik weyob narmaksagusad, deun sogsagusgu:
Isaías 40:3-5

Dulemar-bukidar Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakega Juanʼse duurmaknonidamalad. Juan amarga sogdedaed: “¡Ar bemar naibe-bulegan-mimmiganyob gumalad! ¿Ar doa Bab-Dummad nue-urwe-danikoed-idu-wakinned bemar-odurdaksa? Bab-Dummad-diigi-oglegedgi bemar nuguosurmalad.

Degisoggu, be-daedgine na be oyomar, bemar nue-gwagsamalad, be-isguedga na be bukib binsasmalad. ”Mer unnila na be sogmalo: ‘Anmar Abraham-wagan gumarye. A-ulale, Bab-Dummad anmargi nabir binsaergebye.’ Suli, degisuli. Ar be Abraham-wagwasulile, akarsulid, ar Bab-Dummad sunna we-akwamar Abraham-waganga imaked.
”Deginbali, ar bato akan guar sapi-maligi yoid. Ar degisoggu, sapi nue sanmaksulile, a-sapi siklegoed, ogumaklegega soogi melledoed. Deyob Bab-Dummad dulemar-imakmogoed.”
Ar degi, dulemar Juanʼse egichiar dasunnad, ega sogdedamalad: —Degite, ¿ibu anmar imakmarsunnoe?
Juan, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule suba-gobo nikale, dule-subasulidga gogwen ukmogo. Amba deyob masgunnedsik imakbaloed.
Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamaladi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakega Juanʼse nonimarmogad. Amar ega sogdemarmogad: —Odurdaked-saila, ¿anmardi ibi imakmarmogoe?
Juan amarga sogded: —Melle dulemargi wilub-obichaa be mani gamalo, ar unnila bemarga igar-uklesadba be mani gamaloed.

Degine, suar-ibmala ese egichiarmarmogad: —Anmardi ¿ibi imakmarmogoe? Juan, abin-sogded: —Mer emar-annik gannadba mani suo, degine, mer binsa aimar-ogakansao. Ar bemar na be-bennuklegedgi, gusbin be itomalo.
Dulemar Juan-sunmaked-itobukmaladi Cristo-edarbebukmarsoggu, na e-gwagegi binsabukmalad, we-Juan, Cristo-sogeye. Cristo sogleged, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye.

Juan abin-imakdegu, bela dulemarga sogded: “Ar andi, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imakedid. Unnila diigi an emar-ogdiid, ar dule-baid-danikoeddi, ar bur anba dule-dummadid. Ar e-sapat-dubse-bakar, geg an ei esiked. Ar a-duledi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledgi, degi, soogi be-ognonimaloed.

”Igi dulemar oros-gwag egwamala, deyob, a-dule, oros-gwag-egwaega bato guagwar e-argangi bigbi-gani gwichid. Degi, oros-gwag-nued e-urbed-neggi nue urboed, e-ukadi soogi ogumakoed. Ar we-soode, geg soo-ginnedid, degi-gasii-sadeguad-sood.” We sogledo, dule-dummad oros-gwagyob dulemar-imaknonikoye.
Weyobi, Juan bukidar dulemar-unadii gusad, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi dulemarga sunmakdii gusad.
Herodes dummadga-maigu, e-urba-Felipe-ome-Herodíasʼye-nugad-nikusad-ular, degi, bela-ibmar-isganamar-imaksad-ular, Juan sabsur Herodesʼga ibmar sogsad.
Ibmar-baid-isgana imaksadbali, Herodes esgaryagi Juan-meted.
Diigi-dule-oged-Juan, Bab-Dummad-diigi Jesús-ogsad
Degidgine, bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar-imaknanaigua, Jesús Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imaksamogad. Jesús Bab-Dummadse gotegu, nibnega argade gusad.
Jesúsʼgi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled sanale, nuuyobi aidenonikid, degi, nibneggi gayaburba gollar gusad, sogded: “Be An-Machi-sabed-sunnad gued. An beba weligwar itoged.”
Jesús na e-arbaed imakdegu, deun birga-durgwen-gakambe (30) nikad. Jesús, José-e-machiye bimalanad. Jesús-e-dad-dummagan, wemalad:
